title: Phase 0: Foundation
description: Make the project portable and publicly verifiable before any code exists.

title: Phase 1: API core
description: A production-quality Clean Architecture API that runs locally with one command, plus the governance, documentation, and testing machinery every later phase relies on. Release v0.1.0.

title: Phase 2: Secure CI
description: Every change is built once, then tested, analyzed, scanned, inventoried, signed, attested, and verifiable. Release v0.2.0.

title: Phase 3: Zero-trust platform
description: A reproducible local Kubernetes platform where every hop is authenticated, encrypted, authorized, segmented, observable, and policy-checked. Release v0.3.0.

title: Phase 4: Contracts and GitOps
description: Versioned, consumer-verified contracts and fully declarative delivery with rehearsed rollback. Release v0.4.0.

title: v1.0 launch
description: Turn the public repository into a polished, versioned portfolio release. Release v1.0.0.
